dex.text: Grows so fast in the dark you can hear it squeak and creak. Shy of daylight, and of custard, for different reasons.
dex.fact: Yorkshire forced rhubarb is grown in dark, heated sheds in the Rhubarb Triangle between Wakefield, Morley and Rothwell, and picked by candlelight because brighter light would stop it growing.

dex.text: Spent its youth in a dark shed and came out ready to take on anyone. Tart, tough and not to be argued with before its pudding.
dex.fact: In 2010 Yorkshire forced rhubarb was given Protected Designation of Origin status in Europe, putting it in the same club as Champagne and Parma ham.
